title: IREE target configuration
description: Shared compile and run flags for one iree-run-module target configuration.

config_name.description: Stable identifier used in pytest ids and artifact paths.

target.description: Concrete gfx target selected by pytest.

iree_compile_flags.description: Flags passed to iree-compile for every case using this target.

iree_run_module_flags.description: Flags passed to iree-run-module for every case using this target.

iree_run_module_wrapper.description: Optional command prefix inserted before iree-run-module, such as a RocJITsu launcher and its flags.

skip_run_tests.description: Case names skipped after successful compilation.

expected_compile_failures.description: Case names allowed to fail compilation.

expected_run_failures.description: Case names allowed to fail execution or output validation.
